purpose: AI component registry for choosing existing platform components before generating pages.

pagePatterns.name: recipe-filter-table-page
pagePatterns.title: 筛选区 + 表格工具栏 + 表格 + 页码
pagePatterns.typicalPage: 项目全景管理 - 项目总览
pagePatterns.useWhen: 查询、筛选、列表、分页、导出、新增、编辑、删除

shellContract.filter: Use PlatformQueryPanel. Replace fields only; do not recreate search rows, action gaps, collapse behavior, or responsive grid.
shellContract.tablePanel: Use one platform-surface or PlatformSection containing PlatformTableToolbar followed by PlatformTable.
shellContract.toolbar: Use PlatformTableToolbar. Do not wrap it in a custom width container or override its horizontal padding.
shellContract.pagination: Let PlatformTable or the confirmed Vben/Vxe table shell own pagination and bottom spacing. Do not add page-level .pagination or .ant-pagination CSS.

avoidWhen: 裸写 a-table 后自行补分页、筛选、工具栏
把查询按钮散落在多个 div 中
自写 search-row/search-panel/table-toolbar/pagination 页面壳
relatedRules: TYPICAL-PAGES.md#recipe-1筛选区--表格工具栏--表格--页码

pagePatterns.name: recipe-metric-table-page
pagePatterns.title: 顶部数据指标卡片 + 表格工具栏 + 表格 + 页码
pagePatterns.typicalPage: 智能考勤管理 - 施工管理
pagePatterns.useWhen: 指标、统计、总数、趋势、审批状态、顶部卡片、流程列表

shellContract.metrics: Use PlatformStatCard for metric cards. Do not write a page-specific KPI card shell.
shellContract.filter: If filters exist, keep PlatformQueryPanel instead of turning filters into custom rows under the metric area.
shellContract.tablePanel: Use one platform-surface or PlatformSection containing PlatformTableToolbar followed by PlatformTable.
shellContract.spacing: Use --st-layout-section-gap between metrics, filters, and table panel.

avoidWhen: 自写指标卡壳
把指标、查询、表格揉在同一个 card 里
为了放指标卡而重写筛选区、工具栏或分页间距
relatedRules: TYPICAL-PAGES.md#recipe-2顶部数据指标卡片--表格工具栏--表格--页码

pagePatterns.name: recipe-tree-table-page
pagePatterns.title: 树结构 + 右侧筛选区/表格工具栏 + 表格 + 页码
pagePatterns.typicalPage: 智能考勤管理 - 文档列表
pagePatterns.useWhen: 树、组织、分类、目录、区域、左侧导航、右侧列表

shellContract.tree: Use PlatformTreePanel for the left tree and search box.
shellContract.rightPanel: Use platform surface and tokens for the right content panel.
shellContract.filter: If the right panel has filters, use PlatformQueryPanel or the Recipe-defined platform search slot.
shellContract.tablePanel: Keep PlatformTableToolbar plus PlatformTable as the table shell; do not rewrite toolbar width or pagination spacing for the split layout.

avoidWhen: 自写树面板、搜索框和树容器
左右区块使用随意 card 嵌套
右侧重新手写筛选区、工具栏宽度和分页底部间距
relatedRules: TYPICAL-PAGES.md#recipe-3树结构--右侧筛选区表格工具栏--表格--页码

pagePatterns.name: dashboard-page
pagePatterns.useWhen: 工作台、概览、质量分析、进度看板
avoidWhen: 营销式 hero
裸放图表容器
每个指标重新写卡片壳

pagePatterns.name: platform-layout-shell
pagePatterns.title: 顶部导航栏 + 左侧导航栏 + 内容区页签
pagePatterns.useWhen: 任何正式业务页面默认都处在这套公共布局下

shellContract.header: Top header occupies the full first row, always shows logo and system name, and does not render first-level menus.
shellContract.sidebar: Left sidebar uses platform-rail style, brand green background, collapsed icon plus title, and #0B0C0D 26% hover/active background.
shellContract.pageTabs: Content top area uses ContentPageTabs and PlatformPageTabs to record opened pages with click and close behavior.

avoidWhen: 业务页面内自行重写顶部栏、左侧栏或内容区页签
用传统路径面包屑替代已打开页面页签
页面 scoped CSS 覆盖菜单 hover、页签关闭按钮或系统标题

components.name: PlatformViewToolbar
useWhen: 页面标题、说明、右侧主操作
avoidWhen: 手写页面标题栏
把主操作按钮散落在页面顶部

components.name: PlatformQueryPanel
avoidWhen: 裸写 a-form 并手动调按钮间距

components.name: PlatformTable
useWhen: 需要平台表头筛选、列设置、分页
avoidWhen: 真实业务页已深度使用 useVbenVxeGrid 且未确认替换
大数据量虚拟滚动场景

components.name: PlatformTableToolbar
useWhen: 表格顶部新增、删除、刷新、设置、全屏
avoidWhen: 把工具按钮拆到多个容器

components.name: PlatformSectionTitle
useWhen: 标题中部放分段或视图切换
avoidWhen: 页面里手写标题壳
用绝对定位硬摆标题中部控件

components.name: PlatformSection
avoidWhen: 每个页面自写 card surface

components.name: PlatformEntryCard
useWhen: 工作台或概览页的功能导航卡片
avoidWhen: 只有纯文本标签按钮
结构和视觉完全不同的营销卡片

components.name: PlatformStatCard
avoidWhen: 页面自写指标卡壳和图标尺寸

components.name: PlatformModal
avoidWhen: 裸写 a-modal 并手动调 footer 间距

components.name: PlatformDrawer
avoidWhen: 裸写 a-drawer 并复制页面字段布局

components.name: PlatformEditForm
avoidWhen: 业务页自写整套表单密度

components.name: PlatformPageTabs
useWhen: 内容区顶部记录已打开页面
需要点击切换和关闭访问页面
avoidWhen: 仅展示静态层级路径
页面没有多页面访问记录需求

components.name: PlatformSectionAction
useWhen: 模块标题右侧的刷新、更多、查看更多等文本加图标动作
需要统一模块级 hover 色和箭头方向
avoidWhen: 主按钮或危险按钮
需要下拉菜单的复合操作

components.name: PlatformNoticeList
avoidWhen: 页面已经有稳定复用的复杂卡片形态
每页重新手写消息列表壳和两行内容布局

components.name: PlatformDescriptions
avoidWhen: 手写 label/value 网格

components.name: PlatformFileList
avoidWhen: 每页自写文件图标、大小、状态排版

components.name: PlatformEchartsPanel
avoidWhen: 裸放 ECharts DOM
